Gypsy-Rose Blanchard IS invited to ex-fiance Ken Urker's funeral... despite claims she 'humiliated' him shortly before his tragic death

Gypsy-Rose Blanchard has received an invitation from Ken Urker's family to attend his upcoming funeral following his tragic death.

Actual Article Body:
By JACQUELINE LINDENBERG and SONIA HORON, US ASSISTANT SHOWBIZ EDITOR and JUSTIN ENRIQUEZ, US ASSISTANT SHOWBIZ EDITOR

Published:  11:06 AEST, 7 October 2026   |  Updated:  18:26 AEST, 7 October 2026

Gypsy-Rose Blanchard has received an invitation from Ken Urker's family to attend his upcoming funeral following his tragic death.

Urker was found unresponsive inside his home in Louisiana on Thursday, October 1, the same day he was celebrating his 34th birthday.

It comes despite Urker's sister Autumn claiming that her brother had been 'terrified' and 'humiliated' by Blanchard.

Family sources told TMZ that Blanchard was invited to the funeral service which is set to take place in his home state of Texas at a future date.

Blanchard, 35, has a good relationship with most of Urker's family, including his mother Raina, per the sources, and his parents don't believe she was involved in his sudden passing.

Blanchard, who welcomed 21-month-old daughter Aurora with Urker, is interested in attending the funeral, but also wants to hold an additional service in Louisiana for her loved ones to also attend, the family insiders told TMZ.

The Daily Mail has reached out to reps of Blanchard for comment, but has yet to hear back.

Just days earlier, Blanchard visited Urker's casket with their daughter over the weekend.

Blanchard, whose relationship with Urker began during her seven-year prison sentence for her part in the murder of her abusive mother, Claudine 'Dee Dee' Blanchard, was present for a small viewing at a Louisiana funeral home on Saturday.

She arrived in a black dress and a necklace that Urker gifted her for their two-year anniversary, family sources told TMZ.

During one heart-wrenching moment at the viewing, their daughter Aurora reportedly recognized her father and said, 'Daddy.' Blanchard was also given private time to say goodbye.

Others present at the viewing included Urker's brother, two of his sisters and his mother Raina.

His sister Autumn did not attend, despite sources claiming she was in Louisiana at the time.

It comes after Autumn's claims to the Daily Mail that Urker told her in their final phone call he was 'terrified' that Blanchard would not keep their daughter 'safe.' He also allegedly said that Blanchard had 'humiliated him.'
